research.title: JPL Solar System Dynamics: Astrodynamic Parameters
research.note: Supplies the Sun's gravitational constant, the astronomical unit and the gravitational constants of Mercury and Venus (from the JPL planetary ephemeris DE440). A dated snapshot is kept in data/snapshot.json.

research.title: JPL Solar System Dynamics: Approximate Positions of the Planets (Table 1)
research.note: Supplies each planet's orbit radius and its mean longitude at J2000 and rate, which set where each planet starts on a mission's start date. The game draws every orbit as a circle, so a planet can be a few degrees from its real place.

research.title: JPL Solar System Dynamics: Planetary Physical Parameters
research.note: Supplies each planet's mean radius and orbital period.

research.title: JPL Solar System Dynamics: Planetary Satellite Physical Parameters
research.note: Supplies the gravitational constants of Earth, Mars and the other planets, and the gravitational constant and mean radius of the Moon, Phobos and Deimos.

research.title: JPL Solar System Dynamics: Planetary Satellite Mean Elements
research.note: Supplies each moon's orbit radius and period.

research.title: NASA Planetary Fact Sheet
research.by: NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive
research.note: Used to cross-check the planets' sizes, distances and periods (the page was last updated 18 March 2025).

research.title: Patched conic approximation, Gravity assist, Sphere of influence (astrodynamics), Hohmann transfer orbit
research.note: Supply the four About page facts, reworded; each is linked from the About page with the day it was read.

inspiration.title: Kerbal Space Program
inspiration.note: The idea of planning transfers and gravity assists between real-feeling worlds. Slingshot is the opposite in temperament: no piloting, no tutorial wall, a plan on a quiet chart.

inspiration.title: Flow Free
inspiration.note: The calm, untimed feel of a puzzle that is never lost.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python flight engine in the browser, so there is no server and no build step.

other.title: Kestrel Desk, Wren and the notes on each mission
other.note: The mission desk, the probe and the short notes are invented for this game.
